title: Dan Farah's UFO docufilm quietly revealed insider report on unexplained military base activities and recovered crafts
excerpt: Dan Farah's UFO docufilm, The Age of Disclosure, premiered at the 2025 South by Southwest Film & TV Festival on March 9, 2025. The film was then released in the theatres and eventually on Amazon Prime on November 21, 2025.
content:

Updated Mon, September 7, 2026 at 6:26 PM UTC

Dan Farah's UFO docufilm, The Age of Disclosure, premiered at the 2025 South by Southwest Film & TV Festival on March 9, 2025. The film was then released in the theatres and eventually on Amazon Prime on November 21, 2025.

In this film, several former US government officials and people associated with the disclosure movement claim that there is alien intelligence on Earth. They further claim that this is often subjected to government cover-ups. The film further explains conspiracy theories regarding secret programs, aliens, and institutional secrecy through interviews with ufologists, US government officials, US military employees, and the intelligence community. The film has received mixed reviews from the viewers and critics, while some found it trustworthy, others were skeptical due to the lack of physical evidence.

However, in an interview with Chris Cuomo, Farah revealed that whatever the government officials have claimed in the UFO docufilm is true. He further explained the different kinds of recovered crafts, the decade-long secret and unexplained military base activities. He claimed that these crafts can access restricted airspace, a statement based on Marco Rubio's interview.

Disclaimer: This article reflects the author’s thoughts and opinions on what has been claimed in the Dan Farah UFO docufilm. Reader discretion is advised.

Dan Farah on UFO files, unexplained base activities, and recovered crafts

In an interview with Chris Cuomo on YouTube, Dan Farah, the director and producer of The Age of Disclosure, opened up about the unexplained military base activities and recovered crafts. When Cuomo asked Farah about the different kinds of crafts that had been recovered in multiple ways, Farah corrected him, saying,

"It's not different types of crafts. In the film, some of the officials who investigated this topic break down the flight performance characteristics. Like the things we see these crafts doing. To sum it up, these crafts are performing in ways that our most advanced aircraft cannot."

Farah claimed that these crafts have exceptional speed and are capable of transmedium travel. They can apparently travel from space to air and into the ocean seamlessly. They seem to defy the effects of gravity. He further claimed that these specialized crafts are regularly penetrating military bases and nuclear weapon sites. Farah added how Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that these crafts have access to the restricted and classified airspace. Farah revealed that Rubio's statements alone demand urgent inquiry and investigation.

Dan Farah shared that he had interviewed 34 people for the film who have dropped bombshell reveals and paradigm-shifting information. He questioned if the officials were legally allowed to reveal the information, and stated there might be certain things they are hiding from the citizens. He shared that the truth is classified.

Farah shared that the UAP (Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena) activity over nuclear sites has increased with the progress in harnessing nuclear energy. The leading theory is that the UAP and the intelligent life controlling them are concerned about the US's technological progress. Farah claimed that the monitoring of the nuclear sites is believed by many to be a monitoring of progress until we turn into a threat.

The Age of Disclosure raises questions about whether the officials have withheld information about UAP sightings and suspicious military incidents. However, the interviews of the former military personnel and officials are quite intriguing, but the claims of recovered crafts need proper investigation and evidence.

At the same time, the former officials' revealing certain details about UAP in the interview fuels questions that the government is certainly aware of it and keeping further information a secret. Thus, before we jump to conclusions about the conspiracy theories, a transparent investigation and evidence are required.
